paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The graph illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of the s_pop frequency, with the x-axis labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranging from 1 to 19 in increments of 2, representing the frequency of s_pop events scaled by a factor of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," spans from 0.0 to 1.0, indicating the model's performance. Two distinct lines are plotted: a green line with circular markers and a blue dashed line with square markers. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.37 when s_pop frequency is 1, increases to about 0.69 at frequency 7, dips to around 0.47 at frequency 9, rises to 0.68 at frequency 11, decreases to 0.59 at frequency 13, further drops to 0.51 at frequency 15, and then sharply increases to 1.0 at frequency 17 and remains at 1.0 at frequency 19. The blue dashed line begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.72 at frequency 1, increases to about 0.98 at frequency 5, slightly decreases to 0.96 at frequency 7, rises to 1.0 at frequency 9, dips to 0.92 at frequency 13, and then remains at 1.0 for frequencies 15, 17, and 19. Error bars are present for each data point, indicating variability in the measurements.
